Inter font subset for offline UI use

Source:
- Family: Inter
- Upstream: Google Fonts / fonts.gstatic.com
- Retrieved: 2026-05-22
- Included file: inter-latin.woff2 (latin subset)

Why subset:
- Keep repository/image size small
- Ensure GitHub push/clone remains lightweight
- Preserve offline rendering in constrained networks
